display.purpose: Hero headlines, section titles, card/component headings. Always uppercase.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, lede text, capped at ~52ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, button labels, stat captions, nav links. Always uppercase, wide-tracked.

shadows.name: gold-offset
shadows.purpose: Card/service-tile hover lift on dark sections.

shadows.name: ink-offset
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on light/.light sections, inverted.

motion.name: ease-pop
motion.purpose: Overshoot easing for hover lifts, icon nudges, transforms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — champagne-gold pill with hard offset-shadow hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.7rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.9rem 1.5rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(96deg, #a8862a, #e0c064 45%, #f7edd2 72%, #e0c064); color: #0b0b0c; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.9,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-3px, -3px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 0 #a8862a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e0c064; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary CTA — outlined, inverts to solid bone on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.7rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.9rem 1.5rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 999px; background: none; border: 2px solid rgba(244,244,240,0.28); color: #f4f4f0; transition: all 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.9,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f4f0; color: #0b0b0c; border-color: #f4f4f0; transform: translate(-3px, -3px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 0 #a8862a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e0c064; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Badge
components.description: Tilted sticker-style label that opens every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0b0b0c; background: #e0c064; padding: 0.45em 0.95em; border-radius: 999px; transform: rotate(-1.6deg); }

narrative.overview:
Concrete black as the court, champagne gold as the trophy flashing under the lights. The system reads as confident streetwear luxury: bold, tactile, a little brash, built for a talent-management-and-real-estate firm that earns trust through relationships and receipts, not corporate polish. It explicitly rejects generic corporate-finance minimalism — no navy-and-white advisory-firm blandness, no soft SaaS gradients, no timid restraint. Gold is used with swagger, not sparingly: eyebrows, badges, and stat blocks all wear it loud.

The system is mobile-first and fluid throughout — type sizes and section rhythm scale with clamp() rather than stepping at breakpoints, so nothing looks under-designed at any width. Physicality is the throughline: tilted sticker badges, hard offset-shadow hovers, and grain/marquee texture all say "this was built by hand, not generated."
keyCharacteristics: Concrete-black base with champagne-gold flash, warm amber used sparingly as a second voice
Archivo Black display type in uppercase, tight tracking, paired with clean Space Grotesk body
Pill-shaped buttons and badges, tilted at small deliberate angles (sticker energy)
Hard offset-shadow hovers, not soft blur — physical, not ambient
Fluid spacing/type via clamp(); almost no fixed breakpoint jumps

rules.name: The Loud Gold Rule
rules.body: Champagne gold is not a rare accent here — it's allowed to dominate eyebrows, buttons, and stat blocks at once. Don't dilute it toward a "10% accent" convention; that reads as generic SaaS, not Acid Court.

rules.name: The Uppercase Display Rule
rules.body: Every .display element is uppercase with negative letter-spacing, never sentence case. Mixing case in display type breaks the poster feel.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never soft or blurred (0 4px 24px rgba(...) ambient glows do not belong here). Every shadow is a flat, unblurred offset (Npx Npx 0 0 color) paired with a translate() on hover — it reads as a sticker lifting off a surface, not light falling on a surface. This is deliberate and structural.

dos: Do use the hard, unblurred offset shadow (Npx Npx 0 0 color + translate()) for every interactive lift — it's the system's core physical signature.
Do keep display type uppercase with tight negative tracking; never mix in sentence case for headings.
Do let gold be loud — eyebrows, buttons, and stat blocks can all carry it in the same viewport.
Do apply small deliberate rotation (-1.5deg to -2.5deg) to badges and stickers for the hand-placed feel.
Do gate all hover-only effects behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) so touch never gets a stuck hover state.
donts: Don't use soft/blurred ambient shadows anywhere — it breaks the sticker-on-concrete physicality that defines this system.
Don't default to navy/corporate-advisory minimalism as a "safer" direction; that is the explicit anti-reference for this brand.
Don't treat amber as a second primary — it stays rare, reserved for secondary emphasis only (step dots, stat hover), or it stops reading as a deliberate second voice.
Don't introduce a step-based (non-fluid) spacing or type scale; rhythm here is clamp()-driven and continuous by design.
